who_for: Home security cameras help you check on your home, packages, and pets from your phone. Indoor cameras watch rooms and pets. Outdoor cameras need weather resistance and good night vision.
Plan for ongoing costs. Many cameras need a monthly subscription to save video history, while others store clips locally on a card or hub.

how_we_picked.label: Video quality
how_we_picked.text: We compared resolution, field of view, and night vision clarity, because detail matters when you need to identify a face or a license plate.

how_we_picked.label: Smart alerts
how_we_picked.text: Person, package, and vehicle detection cuts down on useless notifications.

how_we_picked.label: Subscription costs
how_we_picked.text: We noted which features need a paid plan and favored cameras that stay useful without one.

how_we_picked.label: Power and installation
how_we_picked.text: We weighed battery life, solar options, and wired setups against how easy each camera is to install.

how_we_picked.label: Privacy and security
how_we_picked.text: We favored brands with two-factor authentication and clear privacy controls.
